description: This is a test file for a Flutter application that verifies the rendering of the Tic Tac Toe game UI, including the presence of the game title, a 3x3 grid of cells, and the presence of player indicator text. It specifically tests widget rendering and interaction without relying on text markers for players.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the widget test, which initializes the Flutter testing environment and runs the widget tests for the Tic Tac Toe app.
